english.notes: No minimum published. https://admission.princeton.edu/apply/international-students: 'If English is not your native language and you are attending a school where English is not the language of instruction, you must take the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL), the International English Language Testing System Academic (IELTS Academic), the Duolingo English Test (DET) or the Pearson Test of English Academic (PTE Academic).' A test is required, no score threshold stated.

gpa.notes: No GPA or grade minimum published on the admission pages read (apply, international-students); holistic review.

tuition.quote: $68,140 is the tuition for the 2026-27 academic year.
tuition.notes: Also https://admission.princeton.edu/cost-aid/fees-payment-options: 'Tuition: $68,140', estimated cost of attendance for 2026-27 $94,624. 2027/28 not yet published.

scholarship_exists.quote: If offered admission, Princeton will meet 100% of your demonstrated financial need with grant aid.
scholarship_exists.notes: Need-based grants (no-loan policy); need-blind admission. Size depends on need: NEED_BASED_POSSIBLE.

scholarship_international.quote: Princeton is one of a handful of universities that applies the same financial aid policy to international students.
